newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 10.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Consolidated Electric Company of the eastern province to sign on Tuesday four electricity contracts worth 1.16 billion riyals.
- Gas cookers to be banned during haj to avoid a repetition of the Mena blaze last April.
- King Fahd confirms Saudi Arabia's support to Palestinians.
- Saudi Cables Co board of directors to discuss raising the company's capital to 500 million riyals from 300 million riyals on Wednesday.
- Saudi trade with Malaysia is worth more than one billion riyals, commerce minister says.
- Commerce ministry to enforce stiff penalties for people who write bad cheques.
